# Isaiah Chapter 52 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 15 verses]*

*Awake Zion; beautiful feet; departure from Babylon; Fourth Servant Song begins (52:13-53:12)*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news. This chapter awake zion.

*-- LOGOS*
